integrity: The algebraic interval-recurrence and Catalan reflection arguments are supplied together with two independent integer checkers; all claims are tied to these explicit finite or general proofs.
scientific_limitations: Sharp first-zero classification applies to the sixteen-vertex convex matching ensemble; the universal even-size star construction does not prove all-size optimality. No higher-weight zero classification or full convolution rank is claimed. Historical priority comparisons are bounded; reproducible exact finite arithmetic does not amount to independent validation.
title: Sharp fourth-order Walsh cancellation for sixteen-point noncrossing matchings
